reason: I already pay for amoCRM and it's set up, even if it's slow. Switching my client data to a company with 1 to 5 paying customers and no references feels risky.
objection: Is my customer data safe on your server, and are there backups? Nobody I know uses you, and $89 a month is a lot when I earn about $10,000 a year.
would_change_my_mind: A written backup and data-safety guarantee, a free import of my amoCRM data, and a shop owner I can call who already uses it.
